title: Parallel experiment runner (pmap): multi-core CPU experiments, same results

agent_runs.label: M0-24 parallel runner (pmap, 3 scripts, equality checks, tests, docs, records)

notes: fidetype.utils.parallel.pmap: spawn pool in the background CPU class, 1 thread per worker, per-item seeds, input order, auto worker count (free background slots, free RAM), --workers / FIDETYPE_WORKERS caps, initializer + memory-mapped .npy for shared data, per-chunk checkpoints with resume, serial fallback; isolation job registry gets a slots field. Used in M2-18 t15_eval.py (6 fits), R4 split-tables/run.py --stage b2t --workers (R = 200 tables), M4-06 run.py uncached --workers (816-trial replay). Outputs identical to serial: T15 json/md, 16/16 subset tables byte-equal, full rebuild 699/700 byte-equal to the R4 cache (1 differs only in new_decodes), M3-02 split rows = committed, 816/816 decisions. Speed-ups under load with 2-4 workers: 2.1x T15, 2.9x / ~3.4x split tables, 1.9x replay; RAM per B2T worker (0.9-1.3 GB) limits the count while other agents run. Tests tests/test_parallel.py (11); full suite 736 passed / 10 skipped. Results experiments/2026-11-14-m0-24-parallel/results.md.
